profile.campus: Los Lunas, Valencia County, New Mexico (Meta's Los Lunas data center campus; Data Center Dynamics reported seven buildings on the campus as of 2023, with a further two-building expansion announced)
profile.address: 4250, Messenger Loop Northwest, Meta Los Lunas Data Center, Los Lunas, Valencia County, New Mexico, 87031
profile.reading: This Meta data center building (building 4 of 5 mapped in this cluster, westernmost to easternmost ordering) is part of Meta's Los Lunas campus in Valencia County, New Mexico, south of Albuquerque. Meta broke ground here in 2016 with an initial $250 million building; a third data center opened in 2020, and Data Center Dynamics reported the campus had grown to seven buildings by 2023, with a two-building, roughly $800 million expansion then under construction, expected to take about three years and intended to support both current products and future AI hardware generations. The Village of Los Lunas has approved industrial revenue bonds to assist the build-out through Meta's Greater Kudu LLC affiliate, part of a financing structure the village has used across multiple expansion phases. On power, Meta and Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM) marked commercial operation of the Route 66 Solar Facility in July 2022, a 49.5-megawatt, 450-plus-acre solar installation in neighboring Cibola County built by NextEra Energy Resources with more than 150,000 bifacial solar modules, built specifically to help supply renewable power to the Los Lunas data center. Meta's own fact sheet reports more than $2.5 billion invested in the New Mexico campus overall, roughly 400 operational jobs once complete, 1,100 peak skilled-trade construction workers, more than $4.9 million in direct funding to local schools and nonprofits, LEED Gold certification for campus buildings, and a Meta-supported total of 885 megawatts of new renewable energy plus 100 megawatts of battery storage added in New Mexico as part of Meta's global net-zero and 100%-renewable-electricity commitments. Meta does not publish a specific street address, exact building count, or per-building square footage for individual Los Lunas structures; the address above is derived from reverse-geocoding this building's mapped coordinates, not from an operator-published source, and should be treated as approximate.

profile.regional_context: Valencia County sits in the Albuquerque metro area along the historic Route 66 corridor, for which the Meta-linked Cibola County solar facility is named. New Mexico's data center growth has drawn on the state's high solar-resource potential and PNM's renewable-energy procurement, and Los Lunas has used industrial revenue bond financing repeatedly to support Meta's expansions, per Data Center Dynamics reporting on the village's approvals.

reading.body:
Meta does not publish a power capacity figure for its Los Lunas campus. The facility's magnitude for AI scaling therefore cannot be assessed from operator data. New Mexico has 14 mapped data centers and zero published megawatt figures across the state, so this campus cannot be ranked against peers by disclosed capacity.

Meta has invested $2.5 billion and more in this campus since groundbreaking in 2016, with 400 operational jobs at full staffing and 1,100 trade workers at peak construction. The operator reports the campus will run on 100 percent renewable energy and participates in a state-level project to add 885 megawatts of new renewable generation and 100 megawatts of battery storage. Buildings hold LEED Gold certification.

Whether this campus is a binding constraint on AI scaling, a major hub, or one facility among many cannot be determined from published specifications. The absence of a capacity figure from Meta for this site means its role in the company's global compute footprint remains opaque.
